title: Record Metadata
description: Per-data-file metadata for an individual recording within a NEMAR dataset. A data file is a primary recording (e.g., .set, .edf, .vhdr) along with its BIDS sidecar context (channels.tsv, events.tsv, electrodes.tsv, *_eeg.json). The modality is inherited from the dataset; participant info comes from the dataset-level participants.tsv. Only fields that vary per-file belong here.

dataset.description: Parent dataset identifier (foreign key to dataset.dataset_id).

data_name.description: Human-readable name for this data file (e.g., 'ds002718_sub-004_task-FaceRecognition_eeg.set').

bids_relpath.description: BIDS-compliant relative path within the dataset (e.g., 'sub-004/eeg/sub-004_task-FaceRecognition_eeg.set').
